about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Software Developer
about.mainContent:
Hi, I'm Idriss, a front-end web developer specializing in React and e-commerce with four years of experience. I love turning ideas into fast, scalable, and intuitive web experiences. With expertise in Remix.run, Webflow, and Squarespace, I build high-performance platforms that look great and run smoothly.

 Beyond front-end, I'm expanding my full-stack skills to launch indie SaaS projects and share insights on Twitter. I thrive on problem-solving and optimization, ensuring integrations work seamlessly with minimal maintenance. Right now, I'm seeking new opportunities to push web development further.

 Let's build something great together.
about.additionalContent: I'm a software developer with a passion for building web applications. I'm a quick learner and I'm always looking to improve my skills.
